# Importations / nettoyage

```{r}
source("init.R")

library(ggfortify)
library(lmtest)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)

wd <- set_wd()

Total <- sf::st_read(paste0(wd$data, "derived/TotalComplet.shp"),
                     options = "ENCODING=UTF8")
Total <- transform_Total()

collision_faune_diro <- readr::read_csv(paste0(wd$data, 
                                               "raw/collision_faune_diro.csv"))


```

```{r}
MortsNat <- MortsNaturalistes%>%
  dplyr:: mutate(cd_nom = as.numeric(cd_nom),
                 cd_nom_grp_must = dplyr::if_else(cd_nom %in% c("60704", "60658", 
                                                       "60716", "60686", "199752",
                                                       "60674", "60731", "60746"),
                                         111, cd_nom),
                 cd_nom = as.factor(cd_nom))%>%
  dplyr::select(Code_10km, X_10km, Y_10km, 
                date, cd_nom, cd_nom_grp_must,
                paysage_ID, paysage_nom, famille_paysage)%>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry()
```

```{r}
diro <- collision_faune_diro %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    geom_x = as.numeric(stringr::str_match(geom, "POINT \\(([^ ]+)")[,2]),
    geom_y = as.numeric(stringr::str_match(geom, "POINT \\([^ ]+ ([^\\)]+)")[,2])
  )%>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(geom))

diro_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(diro, 
                        coords = c("geom_x", "geom_y"), 
                        crs = 2154)
diro_sf <- sf::st_transform(diro_sf, 
                        sf::st_crs(4326))

carte_bretagne_44 <- sf::st_read(paste0(wd$data,                                    "masques/Masque_Bretagne_Continentale/Masque_Bretagne_Continentale.shp"
                                    )) %>%
  sf::st_transform(2154)%>%
  sf::st_transform(sf::st_crs(4326))

diro_conti <- sf::st_filter(diro_sf,
                            carte_bretagne_44, 
                            .predicate = sf::st_within)

diro_sf <- diro_conti%>%
  dplyr::filter(deppr != 44)

diro_sf <- diro_sf %>%
   dplyr::filter(!(espece %in% c("amphibien", "amphibiens", "autre", "autre oiseau",
                          "castor", "chat", "chauve-souris", "chien", "chouette",
                          "nr", "oiseaux sauf rapace", "rapace diurne", 
                          "rapace nocturne", "rapaces nocturnes", "rapaces diurnes",
                          "reptile", "reptiles")))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(date = as.Date(paste(as.character(annee), mois, 01, sep="-")),
                espece = dplyr::if_else(commentaire == "Furet", 
                          "mustélidé", espece, missing=espece),
                espece = dplyr::if_else(startsWith(espece,"vison"), "mustélidé", espece, missing=espece),
                espece = dplyr::if_else(espece %in% c("martre", "belette", "fouine",
                                                      "hermine", "putois", "autre petit mustélidé"), 
                                        "mustélidé", espece, missing = espece )
        )%>% 
  dplyr::mutate(bdd_originale = "DIRO",
         technique_observation = "Vu",
         etat_biologique = "Trouvé mort : impact routier")%>%
  dplyr::mutate(espece = as.factor(espece)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-date_maj, -annee, -mois, -commentaire, -grp_espece)


diro_sf <- diro_sf%>%
  dplyr::mutate(cd_nom_t = dplyr::case_when(
    espece == "blaireau" ~ 60636,
    espece == "cerf/biche" ~ 61000,
    espece == "chevreuil" ~ 61057,
    espece == "écureuil" ~ 61153,
    espece == "hérisson" ~ 60015,
        espece == "lapin" ~ 61714,
        espece == "lièvre" ~ 61678,
        espece == "loutre" ~ 60630,
        espece == "mustélidé" ~ 111,
        espece == "ragondin" ~ 61667,
        espece == "rat" ~ NA,
        espece == "rat musqué" ~ 61448,
        espece == "renard" ~ 60658,
        espece == "sanglier" ~ 60981,
    .default = NA
  ))%>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(cd_nom_t))%>%
  dplyr::select(cd_nom_t, espece, date, geom, geometry)


diro_sf <- diro_sf%>%
  ajout_famille_paysage() %>%
  ajout_10x10_predetermine()%>%
  dplyr::rename(cd_nom = cd_nom_t,
                Code_10km = CODE_10KM)%>%
  dplyr::select(Code_10km, X_10km, Y_10km, 
                date, cd_nom, 
                paysage_ID, paysage_nom, famille_paysage)

diro <- diro_sf%>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry()
```

```{r}
MortsTotal <- rbind(MortsNat, diro)
```

# Mortalité Toutes données comprises.

### Lapin - ragondin

```{r}
bdd_reg <- tab_glm(MortsTotal, 
                   espece_interet = 61714,
                   espece_benchmark = 61667)
reg <- glm(data = bdd_reg, 
           proportion_interet ~ as.factor(year))
summary(reg)
autoplot(reg)
```

# Toutes données naturalistes

```{r}
Donnes_Nat <- Total%>%
  filter(technique_observation == "Vu")
```

### Lapin - Ragondin

```{r}
bdd_reg <- tab_glm(Donnes_Nat, 
                   espece_interet = 61714,
                   espece_benchmark = 61667)
reg <- glm(data = bdd_reg, 
           proportion_interet ~ year+X_10km+Dist_Ecotone+Dnst_Cultures)
summary(reg)
autoplot(reg) # 239 c'est une proportion de 1 en 2010, talus, 11 ans du site...

bptest(reg, studentize = FALSE) # Homosedasticité okay a 90%
bgtest(reg, type = "F") # On ne peut pas dire qu'il n'y a pas d'autocorrélation des erreurs
shapiro.test(reg$residuals)
```


### Lapin - Chevreuil

```{r}
bdd_reg <- tab_glm(Donnes_Nat, 
                   espece_interet = 61714,
                   espece_benchmark = 61057)
reg <- lm(data = bdd_reg, 
           proportion_interet ~ year+I(year**2)+X_10km+Y_10km+Dist_Ecotone+Ind_Diversite
           )
summary(reg)
autoplot(reg) 

bptest(reg, studentize = FALSE) # Homosedasticité Okay
bgtest(reg, type = "F") # auto corrélation des erreurs
shapiro.test(reg$residuals)
```


### Lapin - Blaireau

```{r}
bdd_reg <- tab_glm(Donnes_Nat, 
                   espece_interet = 61714,
                   espece_benchmark = 60636)
reg <- glm(data = bdd_reg, 
           proportion_interet ~ as.factor(year)+X_10km+Dist_Ecotone+Dnst_Cultures
           )
summary(reg);BIC(reg)
autoplot(reg) 


bptest(reg, studentize = FALSE) # Homosedasticité 
bgtest(reg, type = "F") # Corrélation des erreurs ...
shapiro.test(reg$residuals)
```

### Lapin - Chevreuil+Ragondin

```{r}

bdd_reg <- tab_glm(Donnes_Nat, 
                   espece_interet = 61714,
                   espece_benchmark = c(61667,61057))
reg <- glm(data = bdd_reg, 
           proportion_interet ~
             as.factor(year)+X_10km+Y_10km+Dist_Ecotone+Ind_Diversite
           )
summary(reg);BIC(reg)
autoplot(reg) 

bptest(reg, studentize = FALSE) # Homosedasticité 
bgtest(reg, type = "F") # Corrélation des erreurs ...
shapiro.test(reg$residuals) # Résidus ne sont pas normaux.
```

```{r}
                   espece_benchmark = 61667)
reg <- glm(data = bdd_reg, 
           proportion_interet ~
```
```{r}
             year+I(year**2)+Dist_Ecotone+Dnst_Cultures
           )
summary(reg);BIC(reg)
autoplot(reg) 

bptest(reg, studentize = FALSE) # Homosedasticité 
bgtest(reg, type = "F") # Corrélation des erreurs
```
